lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Tracing the shadows on the hallway wall
Watching the leaves as they softly fall
A single candle burns against the night
Chasing the ghosts of the fading light
[Chorus]
Across the ocean, beneath the silver moon
I find my heart in your quiet room
A thousand miles is a bridge of gold
In every story that we have told
[Verse]
The city hums a low and steady tune
Waiting for the morning to bloom soon
Your name is a whisper in the wind
Where the end and the start begin
[Chorus]
Across the ocean, beneath the silver moon
I find my heart in your quiet room
A thousand miles is a bridge of gold
In every story that we have told
[Bridge]
The space between us starts to fade
In the light of the promises we made
[Chorus]
Across the ocean, beneath the silver moon
I find my heart in your quiet room
A thousand miles is a bridge of gold
In every story that we have told
[Outro]
